customer: We believe our first responsibility is to the patients, doctors and nurses, to mothers and fathers and all others who use our products and services.
performance: Business must make a sound profit.
diversity_inclusion: We must provide an inclusive work environment where each person must be considered as an individual.
safety: working conditions clean, orderly and safe.
community: We are responsible to the communities in which we live and work and to the world community as well.
sustainability: protecting the environment and natural resources.
innovation: Research must be carried on, innovative programs developed, investments made for the future and mistakes paid for.
integrity: their actions must be just and ethical.
